comments.note: §9b.2 validateActiveStages pseudocode: Rule 2 (subsequence/ordering check using lastIndex) implicitly catches duplicate stages before Rule 3 (explicit duplicate check) fires. e.g. ['implementation', 'implementation'] → Rule 2 fires with 'Active stages must follow canonical ordering' rather than Rule 3's 'Duplicate pipeline type'. Non-blocking.
